new_leaves.doc: Scholze, p-adic Hodge theory for rigid-analytic varieties, Forum Math. Pi 1 (2013), Cor. 1.8 with Thms 9.1 and 9.3 and the corrigendum Forum Math. Pi 4 (2016) e6, applied as in diophantine_zq.tex lem:de-rham-descent L10953-10965 (step C3): for F finite over Q_p and X proper smooth over F, H^i_et(X_Fbar, Q_p) is de Rham and the Hodge filtration of D_dR has its jumps in [0, i] (the filtered comparison D_dR = H^i_dR(X) with Fil^0 H^i_dR = H^i_dR, Fil^{i+1} = 0). Lean form: H^i = Q_p (x)_{Z_p} Scheme.EllAdicCohomology (X x_F Spec Fbar) p i (Mathlib's pro-etale l-adic cohomology), sigma acting by transport along 1 x Spec(sigma^-1) (DeRhamScholze.galHX = t10-etale's galH); D_dR = (B_dR (x) W)^{G_F}, Fil^j = D_dR meet (t^j B_dR^+ (x) W). Consequence, not printed form: the print is for rigid-analytic varieties (not in Mathlib); dictionary steps analytification + Thms 9.1/9.3 (in the manuscript), Fbar vs C_p and pro-etale vs etale (on-the-spot, derham-scholze report section 3)
